name: Sink Your Friends' Boats!
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: PlexiglasOG
description: A simple server-side mod that allows you to troll your friends by making their boats sink in water. (Also works on single-player and LAN, but only requires the owner/host to have the mod installed)
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers. Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln development build 2026-11-26 (cdf45c68) (34 classes, 53 members). Not run yet.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers
